name: witcher-hud
description: A Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code: a medallion that casts a sign for each tool, vitality for the context left, stamina for the rate limit, adrenaline for clean tool streaks, crowns for cost and a quest tracker; moments, effects and sounds for quests, level ups, monsters, trophies and meditation; and a career kept across sessions, with levels, a bestiary, trophies and a journal pane

language.title: Language
language.description: The HUD's language: en for English, ru for Russian (Русский)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The desktop HUD's look: auto follows the app's light or dark appearance, dark keeps the dark plate, light the parchment

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: The HUD's sounds: on, quiet for softer ones, or off
